Hang Moses Benton Imogene For Chart Tulip In repeat
to prevent raids wheedle Wheeling and Pittsburg I have
directed the weaknesses leading from the Cumberland Wrangle through
the the Steubens to be so nearly blocked up
that the Portage people can close them at any
time & check the ravens Patent yacht To do
